Our Full Story

Built From Real Journeys, Shared With Purpose

Some of the most defining moments came during university, taking weekend trips with friends when finals were approaching just to clear our minds, or right after exams to unwind and celebrate the journey. Sometimes those escapes meant quick weekend trips to other Caribbean islands, stepping into a different culture, a different rhythm, even if just for a few days. Those trips were never just about the destination. They were about the laughter, the conversations, the freedom, and the feeling of being fully present with the people around you.

That same spirit carried into traveling beyond borders, even taking trips with friends to other countries to participate in 5K walk and run events, simply for the experience, the challenge, and the memories created along the way. It meant visiting family members living different lives across the world, gaining new perspectives, and deepening connections. And sometimes, it was as simple as commuting across towns or traveling with friends to uncover hidden gems right here at home in Jamaica, places you pass every day but never truly see until you slow down and explore.

Through these experiences, it became clear that travel is not just about where you go, but how it makes you feel and who you share it with. Exploring the Caribbean beyond the surface, discovering hidden gems, connecting with people, and experiencing the culture in its most authentic form revealed that these moments were too meaningful not to share.

Whether it is an adrenaline filled ATV ride through Jamaica’s mountains, a peaceful catamaran cruise at sunset, or discovering secluded beaches across the Caribbean, we bring these moments to life in a way that feels authentic, seamless, and thoughtfully curated. More importantly, we give travelers the freedom to curate their own group experiences, blending adventure, connection, and luxury to create something truly their own.

This is more than a business. It is a vision brought to life through passion, shared experiences, and the belief that travel has the power to transform how people feel, connect, and experience the world.

— D. Allen

Book an Experience
Our Story

Built From Real Journeys, Shared With Purpose

Sight Seers Caribbean Adventures was born from a deep love for travel shaped by real experiences, meaningful connections, and moments that stay with you long after the journey ends. From weekend escapes across the Caribbean during university to traveling internationally for experiences, events, and reconnecting with family, every journey revealed that travel is less about the destination and more about how it makes you feel.

Along the way, I experienced both sides of travel, raw, authentic exploration and refined, seamless luxury. That balance became the foundation of what we offer today, experiences that feel effortless, personal, and deeply memorable.

At our core, we are people focused. Every tour and every interaction is designed with intention, creating experiences that bring people closer, inspire connection, and leave lasting memories.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Book A Discovery Call
Is a deposit required to book?
Yes, a non-refundable deposit of USD $15 is required to process your request. This will be applied toward your booking fee.
What is your cancellation policy?
Cancellations made 72+ hours before the tour date may receive a partial refund (excluding the $15 deposit). See our full Refund & Cancellation Policy.
Do you offer group discounts?
Yes! We offer discounted rates for larger groups. Contact us directly for a custom quote for groups of 10 or more travelers.
Can I reach you on WhatsApp?
Absolutely! Message us at +1 (876) 465-0630 on WhatsApp and we'll respond as quickly as possible.
What destinations do you serve?
Jamaica (islandwide), Barbados, Belize, The Bahamas, Saint Lucia, Curaçao, and the Dominican Republic.
How do I book airport shuttle service?
Shuttle services to NMIA (Kingston) and MBJ (Montego Bay) are available for groups of 5 or more. Contact us with your travel details.

Broadcast-Grade, Island-Side

How a Live Session Reaches Your Headset

Our guides carry a professional spatial-capture rig through the craft markets, beaches, and VIP lounges — so what you see on a browser, iPhone, or Apple Vision Pro is crisp, stable, and live.

8K 360° Camera

A spherical Insta360 X4 rides on the guide's rig, capturing everything around them — you choose where to look, not the camera.

Wind-Proof Audio

A wireless clip-on mic with wind muff keeps the guide's voice crisp over market bustle and ocean breeze.

5G Island Uplink

A dedicated 5G hotspot pushes a 25–30 Mbps stream from Ocho Rios or the Hip Strip to our global delivery network.

Any Screen, Any Headset

Browser, phone, Meta Quest, or Apple Vision Pro — WebXR detects your device and offers Enter Spatial automatically.

Guides also carry LiDAR-equipped iPhones to 3D-scan craft items and villa interiors on request — scans open on your device as interactive models you can rotate before buying or booking. Look for the 3D SCAN tag in the In-Session Shop above.

This page outlines when refunds are available, how rescheduling works, what happens during weather disruptions, how private charters are treated, what items are non-refundable, and how long approved refunds usually take to post.

Effective date: 24 June 2025

We aim to balance guest flexibility with the operational realities of running small-group and private adventures across the Caribbean. This policy explains when and how refunds are issued, what is refundable, and what to do if your plans change.

TermMeaning
Guest / Lead GuestPerson whose name appears on the booking confirmation.
Tour DateCalendar date and time printed on your confirmation voucher.
Force MajeureEvents outside our control, such as hurricanes, earthquakes, or civil unrest, that make it unsafe or impossible to operate.
Private Charter / Exclusive ExperienceAny tour blocked off solely for your party, or arranged as a custom itinerary.
When you cancelRefundNotes
7+ calendar days before Tour Date100%Full refund, no fees.
3–6 days before50%50% of total invoice.
Less than 72 hours or no-show0%Non-refundable.

The clock starts at 00:00 local time in Jamaica (GMT-5) on the Tour Date.

Documented Medical Emergency: Email us a doctor’s note within 5 days of the missed tour.

Eligible guests may receive a 75% refund or a one-time free reschedule.

  • We operate rain or shine. Tropical rain is common and not grounds for cancellation.
  • We will cancel for lightning within 5 km, tropical-storm or hurricane watches, or sea-state at or above Beaufort 5.
  • Our captain or guide’s decision is final on safety grounds. Guests then receive a full refund or a reschedule.

Some excursions require a minimum number of guests. If that minimum is not met by 18:00 the day before, we will contact you so you can either join a different time or date at the same price, or receive a 100% refund.

Notice periodRefund
14+ days100% less any unrecoverable third-party costs such as yacht hire or park permits.
7–13 days100% less any unrecoverable third-party costs such as yacht hire or park permits.
Less than 7 daysNon-refundable. Rescheduling incurs a 20% re-booking fee.
  • One complimentary change per booking if requested at least 72 hours in advance.
  • Subsequent changes, or changes requested within 72 hours, incur a US $20 per person admin fee.
  • Name substitutions are allowed until 24 hours prior, free of charge.
  • Park entry fees once remitted.
  • Merchant and bank processing fees, usually 2–3%, which may be withheld by your issuing bank.
  • Gift cards and promotional vouchers may be transferred, but are never refundable for cash.
  • Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 7–10 business days.
  • International card issuers may take an additional 3–5 business days to post the credit.
  • If your card has expired, funds are issued via electronic bank transfer. Any receiver fees are covered by the guest.
  • We may substitute vessels or vehicles of equal or greater standard.
  • We may alter routing for safety or regulatory reasons.
  • If core inclusions such as Dunn’s River Falls climb are removed, guests receive a pro-rated refund, usually 20–40% depending on component value.

We strongly recommend comprehensive travel insurance covering medical emergencies and trip interruption.

This policy is governed by the laws of Jamaica. Disputes shall be submitted to the jurisdiction of the Jamaican courts unless superseded by mandatory consumer-protection statutes in your country of residence.

Minor wording clarifications may occur without notice. Material changes, such as refund windows, will be highlighted on the website 30 days before taking effect.

Privacy Policy

Home/Customer Support/Privacy Policy
Customer Support

Your Privacy, Our Priority

This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, when we may share it, and the steps we take to help safeguard bookings, inquiries and website interactions.

Effective date: 2 April 2026

Sight Seers Caribbean Adventures only collects personally identifiable information on a voluntary basis. You are not required to provide personal information simply to browse the website, but some services such as bookings, quote requests, newsletters, gift cards, support requests and promotional entries may require limited personal details.

We only request information reasonably necessary to provide the relevant service, respond to your questions, process a booking, fulfil a brochure or service request, or send updates and offers you have agreed to receive.

Information you provide may be used to confirm and manage reservations, arrange transportation and excursion logistics, respond to inquiries, deliver customer support, send booking updates, provide requested marketing communications, notify promotion winners, and improve our service experience.

We may also use information in an aggregated or anonymized form for internal reporting, service improvement and website performance analysis.

Sight Seers Caribbean Adventures does not sell your personal information. We do not transfer or disclose personal information outside the business except where necessary to operate a requested service, complete a booking with a trusted supplier or payment provider, comply with law, prevent fraud, enforce our policies, or protect our rights, guests or partners.

If you opt in to promotional emails, you may unsubscribe at any time by using the unsubscribe link in the email or by contacting us directly. Service messages relating to confirmed bookings may still be sent where operationally necessary.

We want you to feel secure when making a booking on our website. Appropriate administrative, technical and organizational measures are used to help protect information against loss, misuse and unauthorized alteration.

However, no website or online transmission can guarantee 100% security. By using the site, you acknowledge that data transmitted over the internet carries inherent risk.

A cookie is a small text file stored on your device. Depending on your browser settings, we may use cookies to support bookings, keep basic preferences, and assist with anonymous traffic analysis such as page visits, visit times and referring links.

You may refuse cookies or accept them individually through your browser settings, but some booking and shopping features may not function properly if essential cookies are disabled.

This website may contain links to websites operated by third parties. These links are provided for convenience and reference only. Sight Seers Caribbean Adventures does not control third-party websites and is not responsible for their content, security, privacy practices or terms.

You may contact us to request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal information you have provided, subject to applicable law, recordkeeping obligations, payment verification and fraud-prevention requirements.

Our website and services are not directed primarily to children acting on their own. Booking information for minors should only be submitted by a parent, guardian or authorized adult traveller.

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect service changes, legal obligations or operational updates. The revised version will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.
